rules.text: Evidence about another printer establishes nothing about this one.
A note older than a later state change does not establish current state.
Contradictory current indications leave a property unresolved, none preferred by recency or source; a decision is unresolved only if its possible values give different answers.
A commanded or attempted action is not completion; only a verification establishes a completed step.
With thermal-transfer media established and method direct thermal, setting thermal transfer is justified.
With direct-thermal media established and method thermal transfer, setting direct thermal is justified.
Thermal-transfer printing needs a loaded ribbon: with ribbon absence established, loading one is justified and returning to printing is prohibited.

A current media/ribbon detection symptom (an operator reporting an out indication despite loaded media, or a controller out alert while loaded) with consistent configuration justifies starting manual sensor calibration or verifying the loading.
Continuing a calibration prompt requires verified completion of that prompt's step; continuing without it is prohibited.
Cancelling calibration leaves calibration incomplete; it is justified when calibration runs under a configuration inconsistent with the media.
Print-method changes wait until calibration is cancelled.

Returning to printing is prohibited during calibration, with a current unaddressed detection symptom or with configuration inconsistent with the media; it is justified when paused with consistent configuration and no such symptom.
An unverified ribbon-load command or reported calibration step or completion justifies verifying it.
Requesting the observation an unresolved decision needs is justified.
An action no rule justifies is not justified.

review_protocol.name: two-tier-frame-review

mechanical.invariance: frames presenting one observable problem (public input under one effective criterion contract, reference revision and target scope; hidden annotations excluded) share one semantic answer: target values, assessed scope, unresolved state, prohibited actions and composed response; rule and assertion citations are provenance
mechanical.limits: mechanical checks establish rendering, provenance, recomputation and assignment consistency, not the prose's domain interpretation

review.scope: every rule/composition branch, unresolved, ambiguous or contradictory frame and condition/language/role/safety stratum, then a seeded sample of the remaining frames
review.actors: human and agent reviewers use one review operation; each record names its reviewer and actor kind (and an agent's model and session) for traceability; actor kind never weights or completes a decision
review.completion: a current evidence confirmation with an empty target confirms the frame's observable evidence, reference memberships and composed answer against the cited sources/rules; only it completes a required frame
review.labels: a label confirmation supports its declared target, or every target when empty; it never certifies evidence fidelity
review.corrections: skip and replace are frame-scoped evidence decisions on the generated frame's binding; a replacement recomputes gold and needs a current evidence confirmation of the corrected binding

review_protocol.reviewed: the used-source contract is complete, every frame passes mechanical validation, every required human frame has a current evidence confirmation, and no dispute or unconfirmed replacement remains; sampled review never means every frame was read
